run_few_shot_qa: run the few_shot_qa function with a question to get a few-shot QA answer from Anthropic
run_few_shot_qa_single: run a single few_shot_qa request and assert the answer contains the expected capital city
stream_few_shot_qa: stream the few_shot_qa answer token by token using text_iter with stream enabled
run_few_shot_qa_batch: run a batch of few_shot_qa requests with multiple questions and print each answer
configure_anthropic_backend: configure sgl with Anthropic Claude backend as the default LLM provider
